composition: createContextGraphProvider(fake graphClient) + createSourceCatalog + createRetrievalPlanner + createOracleContextResolver (delivered @exharness/oracle at executedAt)

results.case: authority registered but reports no snapshot

findings: A matching CONTEXT_GRAPH authority resolves COMPLETE with REVISION and CONTENT_DIGEST STRONG validators.
An authority reporting a newer snapshot yields UNSATISFIED with STALE through the facade.
A registered authority that reports no snapshot yields UNSATISFIED with CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE through the facade.

With no CONTEXT_GRAPH authority registered, the delivered facade pre-observation rejects with the catalog TypeError "missing/ambiguous snapshot authority" before any provider call; the planner alone reports CURRENTNESS_UNVERIFIABLE.
